# Mr. Picked

> Mr. Picked helps local businesses get recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and rank better on Google. We focus on businesses people look for nearby: restaurants, hotels and apartments, towing and roadside assistance, insurance agents, health and beauty, trades and professional services. We work in 6 languages (English, Slovenian, Croatian, Italian, German, Hungarian) in Slovenia, Croatia, Italy, Austria and Hungary.

## What we do

- AI Mirror audit: we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google’s AI answers the questions customers really ask (30 questions in 6 languages) and show where the business appears, where competitors appear instead, and what the AI gets wrong.
- Fix in the first 30 days: Google Business Profile (hours, services, photos, categories), listings corrected on 15+ platforms, and services, prices and contact details made machine-readable on the website.
- Stay recommended: monthly Mr. Picked Report with an AI visibility score, AI-made short videos from the business’s real photos with voiceover and subtitles in 6 languages, review requests after each job or visit, and replies to Google reviews.
- Optional: WhatsApp concierge that answers customers, sends quotes and takes bookings 24/7, and an AI-ready multilingual website.

## Packages (per month, excl. VAT)

- Visible — 390 EUR: AI audit and full fix in 30 days, listings on 15+ platforms, local Google SEO for 10 key searches, 4 Google profile posts a month, monthly report.
- Recommended — 690 EUR: everything in Visible plus 2 AI videos a month in 3 languages, automatic review requests, review replies within 48 h, 50 customer questions and 3 competitors tracked, quarterly results call.
- Concierge — 990 EUR + 490 EUR one-time setup: everything in Recommended plus 4 AI videos a month in 6 languages, WhatsApp concierge 24/7, reminders and no-show follow-up, services and price list online in 6 languages, seasonal campaigns, monthly strategy call.
- Add-ons: AI video pack +3 videos 149 EUR/month; review loop 90 EUR/month; WhatsApp concierge 390 EUR/month + 490 EUR setup; AI-ready website from 1,490 EUR one-off.
- Social media add-ons (Facebook + Instagram + Google posts, made from Mr. Picked content): Social Start 8 posts + 4 Google posts 290 EUR/month (190 EUR with Recommended or Concierge); Social Plus 12-16 posts + stories + replies to comments and messages 490 EUR/month (390 EUR with Recommended or Concierge).
- Lead Engine (Google Ads campaign setup and management, landing page, lead magnet, automated 4–5 email sequence, monthly report on leads and cost per lead): 790 EUR one-time setup + 390 EUR/month, minimum 3 months, only with Recommended or Concierge. Ad budget is paid by the client directly to Google (recommended from 300 EUR/month).
- Monthly contracts, cancel with 60 days’ notice. Promise: higher AI and Google visibility in 90 days, or the fourth month is free.
